about: gbrain-scoped-2026-10: told-company against told-scoped (per-request scope in gbrain), OpenClaw and Hermes on Haiku (per-cell tables, the paired ladder comparison and the minimum detectable differences).

steps.note: This run has two gbrain rungs per harness and no cell without gbrain, so compare-run cannot guess the ladder design and is told it.
paired-mdd.ts only reads the folder, and prints the path it was given in its table, so it reads the committed folder by its repository path, as the published table shows.
